annotations.title: Publish HTML, Markdown, code or JSON page

description: Publish HTML, Markdown, code or JSON content to BrewPage (repository default limit 5 MiB); format omitted -> the server detects it. Returns its primary share link and owner token. Supports password protection, custom TTL, optional filename, and an opt-in top toolbar (showTopBar). When deliveryMode is omitted for a `public` page, the server may publish it on its own subdomain if the page needs browser features a BrewPage link does not provide; the result then includes deliveryModeReason and a delivery notice. Markdown raw HTML is allowlisted: scripts, styles, event handlers, forms and embeds are removed. Returns manageUrl, a private management link (grants control; not for public sharing). Secrets allowed; likely ones are flagged in notices. Private namespace + password suit secrets.

content.description: HTML, Markdown, code or JSON to publish

deliveryMode.description: Optional delivery choice for a fresh publication, independent of password/namespace. Fresh sites and HTML-format pages outside public (including the default unlisted namespace) always use subdomain; an explicit path there still publishes, on subdomain, with a delivery notice. Everything else in any namespace (Markdown, code/text, files, JSON, KV, public HTML) defaults to path (Promotion); public HTML may automatically choose subdomain for browser features. When creation returns an existing publication, it keeps its actual mode and URL.

filename.description: Optional original filename (≤200 chars). Used as title fallback when no <title>/<h1>; immutable on update.

format.description: Omit: server detects html, markdown, code or JSON. `html` keeps code/JSON as HTML; also markdown/md or a code language.

namespace.description: namespace=public: listed in the public gallery and the sitemap, so Google, Bing and AI search can find and index it and people can discover it. Suits anything meant to be found or shared: docs, guides, demos, portfolios, reports, landing pages. Public pages are served right on the brewpage.app domain, which gives them the strongest reach in search; a page whose code needs its own origin (cookies, storage) gets its own subdomain automatically. Anyone can find and read a public page, so it is unsuitable for secrets, tokens or personal data. Omit (default): private. Unlisted and not indexed; anyone who has the link can still open it. Lowercase only: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

ownerToken.description: Optional. Default: BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN, else a new token per create.

password.description: Optional password to protect the page

showTopBar.description: Add a thin top toolbar (filename + Download button + theme toggle) on the served page. Default: hidden.

ttlDays.description: Requested TTL: days as a number, or a string such as '2w', '36h' or '1 month' (default 15 days). The server rounds to whole days and clamps to the allowed range (1-30 by default; owner caps differ), reporting each adjustment in notices; the returned expiresAt is the actual expiry.
